script: Here is a simple way to choose. Start by listing the three things you enjoy most, such as writing, colours, talking to people, or organising. Then list how much time you have each day, and whether you own a laptop. Now pick two skills that match both lists. Next, spend one week on a free introductory lesson for each of your two skills. Keep the one you enjoy more, and the one you can repeat each day without dreading it. Then commit to that skill for at least ninety days before you change. Changing your skill every week is the most common reason people stay at zero. Let us test your choice with an example. Suppose you enjoy writing, and you have one hour a day on a phone. Content writing may suit you, because you can write on a phone, and the practice fits short sessions. Now suppose you enjoy colours, and you have a laptop for two hours in the evening. Canva design may suit you better. Both choices are good.
